feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate reverts sensor_size from 0.016 (iteration 7) to 0.012 and keeps the iteration 5 design (score 75.779, the best raced so far): kp 2.0, ki 0.3, base_speed 1.0, search_right, sensor weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], and sensor x positions at -0.04, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.04. It changes one field relative to iteration 5, kd from 0.1 to 0.2. Iteration 7 showed that the 16 mm footprint lowered progress on the oval (0.29 to 0.18) and left s-bend and slalom essentially flat, so the sensor revert is well supported. Iteration 6 showed that kp 1.6 lost progress on every track, so kp 2.0 stays. Every raced run so far ends with exactly one line-loss event and max_error of about 0.061 to 0.067 m, above the 0.06 m limit, while steering oscillation stays low (0.10 to 0.16). The failure is therefore a slow drift to one edge, and a modest increase in derivative action is a reasonable single-variable test of that drift. The candidate is valid and differs from the best raced design by one field, so it is worth racing now rather than revising. Read the race this way. (1) If progress is at least as high as iteration 5 (oval about 0.29, s-bend about 0.15, slalom about 0.11) and max_error falls toward or below 0.06 m, keep kd 0.2 and test base_speed 1.1 with search_right, since speed trades progress between the oval and bend tracks. (2) If progress falls, or steering_oscillation rises clearly above the 0.16 seen in iteration 5, revert kd to 0.1 and keep the same test for base_speed 1.1. (3) If max_error stays near 0.063 m on every track whatever kd does, damping is not the limit, and the next lever is base_speed, not further sensing changes.
requested_changes: Race as written. If progress matches or exceeds iteration 5 on all tracks and max_error falls, keep kd 0.2 and test base_speed 1.1 with search_right and kp 2.0, since iterations 3 and 4 showed speed moves progress between the oval and the bend tracks.
If progress falls or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.16 with kd 0.2, revert kd to 0.1 (iteration 5 setting) and test base_speed 1.1 from there.
If max_error stays near 0.063 m on every track whatever kd does, stop tuning damping and test base_speed 1.1 alone, keeping the iteration 5 gains and sensor_size 0.012.
